pages.text: Medicine goes from 0 to 10. It does not grow by itself: the game master sets it (or the RP Perks attribute).$(br2)- $(l)0–2$() — first aid: bandages, tourniquet, pills, pens.

- $(l)3$() — sutures, blood donation and transfusion, the lab.$(br)- $(l)$(cfg)4$()$() — numbers are shown, dose selection with pens and syringes.$(br)- $(l)5–6$() — injected antibiotics, atropine, diazepam, intubation.$(br)- $(l)7+$() — surgery, anesthesia, organs, amputations.
Higher level — faster and more precise, easier minigames.
